findings.title: Omitted live consumer: issuance-exhaustion suite hashes the editable c2 test and is classified preserved-input outside the affected roster
findings.evidence: tests/protocol-v3-issuance-exhaustion-n1prime-c.test.ts:338-339 asserts sha256(artifact.path) === artifact.sha256 for every contract.immutableArtifacts entry; tests/fixtures/phase-n1prime-c-exhaustion/paired-issuance-contract.json:20-23 pins correctedC2Test = tests/protocol-v3-independent-reference-vectors-n1prime-c2.test.ts at d1d4751c…. The c2 test is classified editable-current-owner (inventory.json:2071-2081) and must be retitled per owner map §5, so its bytes change in GREEN. The exhaustion test is classified preserved-input (inventory.json:2084-2093), is absent from affectedCurrentTestFiles (:77-100) and from gate-plan.mjs greenMainAndIsolation, yet is selected by root-test-lifecycle-contract.json:50 and runs under `pnpm test` (test.yml:30). The inventory even records the dangling reference (historicalRecordsWhoseLiveTargetsChange :2292-2297) without propagating it to the consumer's classification. After GREEN this suite fails and no owner is authorized to change it.
findings.violated_requirement: Complete consumer coverage; historical test supersession without suppression; no opportunistic repinning after RED begins

findings.title: Contract does not state which inventory records are byte-compared to base; as derived it silently byte-freezes the root Vitest config, workspace, ordinary CI workflow and four never-pinned tests
findings.evidence: inventory.json classifies vite.config.mts (:2135), vitest.workspace.ts (:2147) and .github/workflows/test.yml (:271) as preserved-input, and limits[1] (:2571) defines preserved-input as byte preservation; README:54-56 says the root manifest protects the complete selected inventory and :99-100 says to freeze the required path inventory in the validator, while :151 compares 'protected inventory ... bytes to base'. The existing root checker governs these three files semantically only (check-protocol-v3-freeze.mjs:509-533 validateTestLifecycle; they are absent from freeze-policy-v3.json:64-112), and the v2 checker explicitly rejects byte-freezing CI/CODEOWNERS files (check-protocol-freeze.mjs:495-498). vite.config.mts:11-112 carries ~100 package aliases edited by ordinary development; byte-freezing it under registry governance makes every alias addition a signed baseline amendment. The same unstated widening applies to tests newly owned only by current-contract (anchor-trust :1832, live-journal parity :1794, author-auth p6 :1908, successor red :2047), contradicting README:101 that the policy is the canonical digest home consumers bind to. RED and GREEN cannot implement protectedPaths consistently from this text.
findings.violated_requirement: Scope custody: fixed required source roster vs byte-protected inventory must be explicit; no unauthorized widening beyond the registry-governance repair

findings.title: Historical-record derivation misses the frozenTuple family whose live targets change
findings.evidence: walk() only matches keys that are inventory paths or {path, sha256} objects (:110-113) and only visits tests/fixtures/*.json preserved inputs (:106,116). It therefore omits records keyed freezePolicyPath/freezePolicySha256/protectedPathStatesSha256: docs/protocol/ed25519-acceptance-profile-v3.json, docs/protocol/blueprint-artifact-profile-v3.json, supplements/ed25519-acceptance-profile-v1/vectors.json, supplements/blueprint-artifact-profile-v1/profile.json:54-60, tests/fixtures/phase-0g2s/ed25519-acceptance-profile-contract.json:11-17 and tests/fixtures/phase-0j-b-v3/blueprint-runtime-contract.json:69-75, all pinning root policy fa2a69d4… and the 47-path state digest 023e7b50…. README:96-98 presents inventory.json as the mechanically derived list of historical records whose live targets change; the owner map §3 covers them only in prose.
findings.violated_requirement: Complete inventory; exhaustive classification of historical records that must stop being dereferenced

findings.title: Frozen 240-second whole-file ceiling is unsupported for controlled-repository suites and cannot be retried once frozen
findings.evidence: test() fixes ceilingSeconds: 240 per file for all 28 roster entries. verification.md:54-68 requires each routing family to execute runner.sh (bash + extracted v2 + root Node processes) in fresh Git fixtures carrying the ~100-record inventory plus the 28-file v2 closure for ≥10 execution controls, and seal/pacemaker suites each spawn five controlled repositories (phase-5a:583-623, phase-5d:941-976). The retained successor suite in the same roster already needs 600 s per case (tests/protocol-v3-freeze-successor-v1-red.test.ts:670,679,696). verification.md:8 says ceilings stop a run and do not authorize retries, and README:283 requires limits frozen before execution, so an under-evidenced ceiling becomes an unrecoverable stop.
findings.violated_requirement: Actual readiness execution; implementable frozen gate roster

findings.title: 'Required-bump rule governs subsequent registry changes' implies a checker transition that does not exist
findings.evidence: Step 3 (README:151-152) rejects any protected-byte difference from base, and no in-band registryVersion transition is defined, unlike v2's validateVectorTransition (check-protocol-freeze.mjs:252-271). Any future registry change is therefore another out-of-band baseline amendment; the text should say so rather than attribute governance to registry-v1.json:1707-1710 changeControl.
findings.violated_requirement: Explain intentionally changed current acceptance predicates

findings.title: Candidate fileEntries mode/type source is unspecified
findings.evidence: README:116-121 requires fileEntries {type, mode} for every present file but does not say whether the candidate's mode/type comes from the index (git ls-files --stage), from worktree lstat, or both, nor how untracked entries (no index mode) or index/worktree disagreement are treated. derive-inventory.mjs:92-98 asserts agreement, but that rule is not in the checker contract.

findings.title: Collector labels decoded-text digests as sha256 and performs a transient write into the selected root
findings.evidence: sources[].sha256 hashes TypeScript's decoded source.text (BOM-stripped), so it cannot be cross-checked against inventory/policy byte digests without a note. Line 33 loadConfigFromFile bundles vite.config.mts with esbuild, which writes and removes a vite.config.mts.timestamp-*.mjs file inside the checkout during collection; stage custody that snapshots the root concurrently may observe it.
findings.violated_requirement: Fresh strict compiler provenance; preserve main built outputs and custody

findings.title: Derivation script path handling and regeneration guards are brittle
findings.evidence: Line 7 uses new URL(import.meta.url).pathname (percent-encoded) instead of fileURLToPath. Line 145 permits --write only over the superseded inventory hash c4e0c69d…, so the frozen candidate cannot be regenerated in place; line 85 asserts proposed RED files are absent, so the script cannot be rerun after RED to detect classification drift.

findings.title: Disposition of the pure child base/head evaluators is inconsistent between README and owner map

State whether they are kept as explicitly non-authoritative test seams or removed with assertions moved to the root seam.
